item.title: 8BitDo Reveals Its Own GameCube Controller For Switch 2

description.p: And it's more affordable than Nintendo's.8BitDo, known for its work in providing excellent retro-inspired controllers for modern systems, has announced the GC Bluetooth Gamepad to celebrate the GameCube's 25th anniversary. It's currently scheduled to launch on 10th December 2026.Compatible with Switch, Switch 2, and Windows, the GC controller maintains the core shape and layout of the iconic GameCube pad, but adds in a bunch of modern upgrades like TMR sticks and Hall Effect triggers. Priced at $49.99, it undercuts Nintendo's official offering by $20 and is available for pre-order now.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Talking Point: As A Parent, What Worries You Most About Gaming?

description.p: Nintendo's guide aims to highlight the benefits.Over the summer, I replayed Ocarina of Time (1998) with my kids. I hadn't intended to, but it dawned on me that once the gorgeous remake landed, the original's visible polygons might not hold the same appeal for them. It was selfish, really, but I wanted them to experience the original magic as I did.I held the pad but let them direct me, staying silent or feigning ignorance about puzzle solutions, letting them speculate and point out chests and switches I'd intentionally run past, involving them in an adventure they don't quite have the dexterity to control themselves.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Civilization Developer Firaxis Games Cuts A Third Of Its Staff, Studio Head Departs

description.p: Grim.A new report from Bloomberg reveals that Firaxis Games, the developer behind Civilization and XCOM, has cut around one third of its staff. Meanwhile, its studio head Heather Hazen will also depart.Approximately 60 people have been laid off as work on a new XCOM stalled over the Summer, with the game reportedly missing a huge milestone. Development will continue, but it will likely be met with a pretty drastic shake-up.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
